claim: 7xg4 is multichain while 6n40 is a single-chain structure in the provided files.
Among individual 7xg4 chains, chain L gives the highest average TM-score against 6n40:A in the implemented approximation.
The best mapping has low structural similarity by TM-score and high RMSD, indicating only weak global correspondence under this approximation.
Concatenating all 7xg4 chains does not improve the TM-score relative to the best single-chain match.
Results are an approximation rather than an exact Foldseek-Multimer or US-align reproduction because those binaries were unavailable.
